title: Hydrocarbons - Melting Point vs. Molecular Weight
description: Calculate melting points of pure hydrocarbons (n-alkanes, alkycyclopentanes, alkycyclohexanes, and alkybenzenes) based on molecular weight using Riazi and Sahhaf equations. Supports carbon ranges C5-C42 depending on hydrocarbon type with typical accuracy of 1-1.5%.

components.content:
## Hydrocarbon Melting Point Calculator

This calculator uses the Riazi and Sahhaf equations to estimate melting points for different hydrocarbon groups:

- **n-Alkanes (Paraffins)**: Carbon range C5-C40
- **n-Alkycyclopentanes (Naphthenes)**: Carbon range C7-C41
- **n-Alkycyclohexanes (Naphthenes)**: Carbon range C7-C20
- **n-Alkybenzenes (Aromatics)**: Carbon range C9-C42

**Equations:**
- TM (n-alkanes) = 397 - exp(6.5096 - 0.14187·M^(2/3))
- TMCP (cyclopentanes) = 370 - exp(6.52504 - 0.04945·M^(2/3))
- TMCH (cyclohexanes) = 360 - exp(6.55942 - 0.04681·M^(2/3))
- TMA (aromatics) = 356 - exp(6.62282 - 0.10019·M^(2/3))

where M is molecular weight in g/mol and TM is melting point in Kelvin (K)

outputs.label: Melting Point
outputs.formula: IF(inputs.hydrocarbon_type='alkanes', 397 - EXP(6.5096 - 0.14187 * POWER(inputs.molecular_weight, 2/3)), IF(inputs.hydrocarbon_type='cyclopentanes', 370 - EXP(6.52504 - 0.04945 * POWER(inputs.molecular_weight, 2/3)), IF(inputs.hydrocarbon_type='cyclohexanes', 360 - EXP(6.55942 - 0.04681 * POWER(inputs.molecular_weight, 2/3)), IF(inputs.hydrocarbon_type='aromatics', 356 - EXP(6.62282 - 0.10019 * POWER(inputs.molecular_weight, 2/3)), 0))))

outputs.label: Melting Point
outputs.formula: IF(inputs.hydrocarbon_type='alkanes', 397 - EXP(6.5096 - 0.14187 * POWER(inputs.molecular_weight, 2/3)), IF(inputs.hydrocarbon_type='cyclopentanes', 370 - EXP(6.52504 - 0.04945 * POWER(inputs.molecular_weight, 2/3)), IF(inputs.hydrocarbon_type='cyclohexanes', 360 - EXP(6.55942 - 0.04681 * POWER(inputs.molecular_weight, 2/3)), IF(inputs.hydrocarbon_type='aromatics', 356 - EXP(6.62282 - 0.10019 * POWER(inputs.molecular_weight, 2/3)), 0)))) - 273.2

outputs.formula: (IF(inputs.hydrocarbon_type='alkanes', 397 - EXP(6.5096 - 0.14187 * POWER(inputs.molecular_weight, 2/3)), IF(inputs.hydrocarbon_type='cyclopentanes', 370 - EXP(6.52504 - 0.04945 * POWER(inputs.molecular_weight, 2/3)), IF(inputs.hydrocarbon_type='cyclohexanes', 360 - EXP(6.55942 - 0.04681 * POWER(inputs.molecular_weight, 2/3)), IF(inputs.hydrocarbon_type='aromatics', 356 - EXP(6.62282 - 0.10019 * POWER(inputs.molecular_weight, 2/3)), 0)))) - 273.2) * 1.8 + 32
